command: claude CLI 2.1.285 print mode (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <porting system prompt>, prompt file on stdin, run from an empty directory)
notes:
Defects of the original kept (behaviour unchanged, documented in the code):
1. SUB-MAIN line 29: the extension test trusts EIBCALEN rather than the caller's real storage. CALINK
   line 46 LINKs its 100-byte WS-CA100 with LENGTH(500). EIBCALEN is then 500, so CASUB writes
   CA-EXT-FLAG and CA-EXT-DATA (offsets 100-499) over 400 bytes of CALINK storage past WS-CA100.
   One-line fix (CALINK): LINK with LENGTH(LENGTH OF WS-CA100), or pass a 500-byte area.
2. SUB-MAIN lines 27-28: CA-SEEN-LEN (offset 7-8) and CA-REPLY (offset 29-48) are written whenever
   EIBCALEN > 0, even when the caller passed fewer than 49 bytes. This overwrites storage past a short
   COMMAREA. One-line fix: guard those MOVEs with IF EIBCALEN >= LENGTH OF CA-HEAD.

Porting decisions:
- MOVE EIBCALEN TO CA-SEEN-LEN is ported as a straight copy. Both fields are PIC S9(4) COMP, and the
  compiler copies the halfword for a same-PICTURE binary move. EIBCALEN is 0-32763, so no value is
  lost in the halfword.
  - The one uncertainty is a TRUNC(STD) build, which could cut a value above 9999 to its low 4 digits.
  - The proven inputs are 0, 100 and 500, so the harness does not exercise this; it is the oracle if
    it ever differs.
- EIBCALEN null (the whole record, #4009) is treated as 500, the LENGTH OF DFHCOMMAREA.
- runTask writes the CATRACE item through task.writeqTs, as the 11 bytes of WS-MSG in EBCDIC (IBM1047).
  'NO COMMAREA' has the same bytes in CP037.
- The WRITEQ has no RESP option, so any condition it raised would be CICS's default abend. With a
  fixed LENGTH(11) this cannot happen, but the abend path is kept.
- executeCasub has no COMMAREA, so it ports the EIBCALEN = 0 path: it writes 'NO COMMAREA' through the
  generated writeqTsCatraceL22.
- handleLink runs the same logic on the passed DTO with EIBCALEN = 500 (the whole record), or the
  EIBCALEN = 0 path when the request is null.

Facts: no field-tested fact is contradicted by the source. The cics_resources, commarea_contracts and
interface facts ('open') match the program: CATRACE is written with LENGTH(11). The inbound LINKs are
line 42 with 100 bytes, line 46 with 100 bytes of storage but LENGTH(500), and line 50 with none.
